title: Oozing Mediterranean Molten Dumplings
description: Savor the rich flavors of the Mediterranean in these delightful dumplings filled with a molten, tangy mixture. Perfect for a solo dinner or as a light meal with friends.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Combine chickpea flour, olive oil, red wine vinegar, water, lemon juice, garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper in a mixing bowl.
Stir until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Use a pastry bag or a plastic bag with a corner cut off to pipe the dough into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Soak the balls in cold water for 10 minutes to activate the sodium alginate.
Drain the balls and gently place them into a hot pot of water with calcium chloride.
Cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the hot pot and serve them immediately with your favorite dipping sauce.
